FounderProfile.title: FounderProfile
FounderProfile.description: Customizable founder profile and visual theme settings for Friends Portfolio by Arpan.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID who owns this portfolio.

aimInLife.description: Founder personal aim in life statement.

goodFriends.description: Bounded list of featured good friend names (max 20).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

FriendEntry.title: FriendEntry
FriendEntry.description: A published friend portfolio card and associated golden trophy hall honor.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID who owns this friend portfolio.

note.description: Special friendship memory or personal note.

avatarPreset.description: Visual avatar preset style when no local photo is set.

trophyId.description: Unique golden trophy badge identifier such as TRP-1042.

trophyTitle.description: Trophy Hall honor title awarded to this friend.

closeFriend.description: Whether this friend is highlighted in the Good Friends inner circle.

cheersCount.description: Number of celebration cheers awarded in the Trophy Hall.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when published (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).
